$Comment: Frost beam bolt 1-4 (2026-10-21): fast straight bolt (LaunchForce 70, no gravity). ❌ 2026-10-21: the ProjectileSpawn AttachBeam (vanilla ChainHook pattern) crashed the world: 'Entity already contains component type BeamComponent' (AttachBeamInteraction adds the beam with commandBuffer.addComponent on the context entity, which here was the king, so the second bolt found one already). Removed; the bolts fly without a beam until another way is found. 2026-10-21 (playtest: bolts out of the throwing hand): SpawnOffset is relative to his eyes and turned by his look (ProjectileConfig.getCalculatedOffset: rotateX(pitch), rotateY(yaw)); forward is -Z (vanilla Projectile_Config_ChainHook Z -0.5), so the old Z 1.0 started the bolt a block behind his head. Right hand: X 0.45 (right), Y -0.45 (hand height), Z -0.7 (in front). If it comes out of the wrong hand in game, swap the X signs here and in _L. 2026-10-21 (playtest: some bolts went into the ground in front of a short target): SpawnOffset Y is 0. HeadMotionAim corrects its aim for the spawn point with ProjectileComponent.computeStartOffset, which subtracts SpawnOffset.Y (it takes +Y as DOWN), while the spawn itself (ProjectileConfig.getCalculatedOffset) adds it (+Y = up). With Y -0.45 (hand height) the aim thought the bolt left 0.45 ABOVE the eyes while it left 0.45 BELOW, so it flew about 0.9 below the aim line. Only Y 0 agrees on both sides; X (side) agrees, so the hand side stays. 2026-10-21: X ±0.2 (was ±0.45). The burst roots have no AimingReference, so the aim makes no side correction and every bolt flies parallel to the aim line, X blocks to the side; at 0.45 a bolt could pass beside a thin target (a player is 0.65 wide). 2026-10-21 (playtest: not every bolt of the bursts and the rain was heard): launch sound SFX_AT_Ice_King_Bolt_Shot (art: the staff shot cut to 0.6 s, 12 at once) instead of the vanilla SFX_Staff_Ice_Shoot (2.5 s, only 5 at once, so later quick bolts were silent). The _L/_R children inherit it.
